column1: # Every metric family the Python api registers, with its Go status: the
# route-counter inventory. Built from an executed sweep (the Python api
# tests run with a plugin that recorded which family fires under which
# route) and, where the sweep saw a family only outside a request, from the
#   type lazy:<type> = registered only when its code first runs, so absent
#       from the import-time listing the oracle takes
#   ported           = the Go api counts it wherever Python does; the oracle drives it
#   partial          = the Go api counts it on some of Python's routes (note); the oracle drives it
#   route-missing    = a route the Go api serves fires it in Python; the Go api does not count it yet
#   route-not-ported = fired by a Python route the dho api does not serve
#   other-go-service = fired by a route another Go service serves (the query-api)
#   worker           = fired by job/worker code, not an api route
#   python-only      = Python-api machinery with no Go counterpart to port
#   retired          = fired by code that no longer runs (Celery)
#   unused           = no caller left in the Python source
